example.task: Determine whether a visibly playable silent MP4 has an audio stream.
inputs: Original abstract two-second MP4 with deliberately silent AAC audio
steps: Use ffprobe to enumerate video, audio and duration.
Run FFmpeg silencedetect at -50 dB over at least a quarter second.
Compare reported silence duration with the file duration.
example.result: ffprobe reported H.264 320×180 video at 24 fps and an AAC stream. FFmpeg reported silence from 0 to 2 seconds.
example.readerImpact: Sound can be absent in playback even when a file contains an audio track.
example.limits: A local sample file, not a SpicyBox export. No vendor format, resolution, audio behavior or output quality was measured.
example.conditions: Local Windows workstation; original synthetic or numerical sample only; all inputs local.

limits: No SpicyBox account operation, personal photo upload, purchase, generation or export test was performed.
